reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount/getWorstCaseRange pattern and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the matcher's tolerance.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; schedule-template's own isbetween ternary is replaced by the shared helper.

placement.why: The new getWorstCaseApproxAmount sits next to getWorstCaseRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts and getScheduledAmount dispatches to both.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule, though it also passes op at display-only list/table sites, changing what the '~' amount shows in the UI.

maintainability.why: Clear named helpers and one dispatch point; the positional op inserted before inverse is a slightly fragile signature change.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount (with getWorstCaseApproxAmount) in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; every planning caller (api, schedule-template, forecast, schedules app, preview, Balance) passes its op to it
